title: Readability after gate sealing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a list of vertex indices, let $G$ be a list of gates, and let $o$ be a vertex index. Suppose $o<n+|G|$, every index in $L$ is less than $n+|G|$, and every vertex $v<n+|G|$ with $v\ne o$ and $v\notin L$ is read by at least one gate in $G$. After sealing the indices in $L$ starting from $(G,o)$, every vertex below $n$ plus the resulting gate count, except the resulting output vertex, is read by at least one resulting gate.
hypotheses_covered: Every index in $L$ is less than $n+|G|$
Every $v<n+|G|$ with $v\ne o$ and $v\notin L$ has positive fanout in $G$
